data.text:
The evidence confirms that the traffic drop and site outages on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005 from 01:30 to 04:30 (T1, ALR-0005) were caused by planned transport network maintenance (MW-0003) executed on fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A from 01:35 to 04:28 (T3). Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised at 01:39 (T5) and cleared concurrently with the maintenance window's completion. Competing explanations like unplanned transport failure or bad configuration changes are ruled out by the maintenance record and absence of changes (T2).

Traffic in Grand Tunis dropped last night due to routine transport network maintenance (MW-0003) performed on the fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A connecting sites S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005. The maintenance window ran from 2026-09-07 01:35 to 04:28, perfectly matching the onset and recovery of the `SITE_DOWN` alarms (ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143) and availability/traffic drops observed between 01:30 and 04:30.

data.markdown:
# Grand Tunis Traffic Drop Due to Planned Transport Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-TUN-01-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Maintenance window timing and scope directly match the site outages and alarms, with no configuration changes or transport failures found.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-07 01:30 to 2026-09-07 04:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-07 01:35
- **Affected:** S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-005

## Summary

Routine transport network maintenance executed on fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A caused temporary service interruptions on connected sites.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in Grand Tunis for three hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-07 01:30: Traffic, active users, and availability drop detected on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005. [T1, ALR-0005]
- 2026-09-07 01:35: Routine transport maintenance window MW-0003 starts on fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A. [T3, MW-0003]
- 2026-09-07 01:39: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-TUN-003, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-005. [T5, ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143]
- 2026-09-07 04:22: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm clears on S-TUN-005. [ALM-000143]
- 2026-09-07 04:23: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms clear on S-TUN-003 and S-TUN-002. [ALM-000141, ALM-000142]
- 2026-09-07 04:28: Routine transport maintenance window MW-0003 completed on LNK-TUN-01-A. [T3, MW-0003]
- 2026-09-07 04:30: Alert ALR-0005 regarding site availability and traffic drop ends. [T1, ALR-0005]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005 for 3 hours starting at 2026-09-07 01:30. [T1, ALR-0005]
- Completed maintenance window MW-0003 overlapped the incident timeframe from 2026-09-07 01:35 to 2026-09-07 04:28 on LNK-TUN-01-A. [T3, MW-0003]
- No configuration changes occurred on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-005 or its parents between 2026-09-06 18:00 and 2026-09-07 06:00. [T2]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms were raised on the affected sites at 01:39 and cleared concurrently with the maintenance window completion. [T5, ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143]
- No external events were recorded across all regions during the queried timeframe. [T7]
- Fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A acts as the parent transport link for S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005. [T6, S-TUN-002]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-TUN-01-A: confirmed. Maintenance window MW-0003 on parent link LNK-TUN-01-A precisely matched the timing and scope of the site outages and alarms. [T3, MW-0003]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-A: rejected. The outage was explicitly covered by scheduled routine transport works in the maintenance records rather than an unplanned failure. [T3, MW-0003]
3. **bad_change** at S-TUN-002: rejected. Change management check confirmed zero changes occurred on the affected sites or their parents during the incident window. [T2]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0004: Involved a traffic spike on entirely different sites (S-TUN-011, S-TUN-013) earlier in the evening and did not cause the drop.
- T2: Checked for configuration changes on affected nodes and parents, but none were found to have occurred.
- T7: External events were checked across all regions, but none were recorded during the window.

## Recommended actions

- Verify post-maintenance traffic normalization on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-005.
- Ensure future transport maintenance notifications clearly alert downstream teams of expected service interruptions.
